# adds_access_rule (Resource)

~> **Deprecated.** `adds_access_rule` has been renamed to [`adds_ace`](ace.md). This alias
still works but will be removed in a future release. Migrate each resource with
`terraform state mv adds_access_rule.<name> adds_ace.<name>`.

Manages a single access control entry (ACE) on an Active Directory object.

This resource is **non-authoritative**: it manages only the ACE it declares and never touches inherited ACEs, other trustees, or inheritance settings on the target. To own a target's entire DACL authoritatively instead, use `adds_acl`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "adds_organizational_unit" "servers" {
  path = "Contoso/Servers"
}

resource "adds_group" "server_admins" {
  name  = "Server Admins"
  path  = "Contoso/Groups"
  scope = "DomainLocal"
}

# Create and delete computer objects in child OUs.
resource "adds_access_rule" "create_delete_computers" {
  target                = adds_organizational_unit.servers.distinguished_name
  trustee               = adds_group.server_admins.sid
  rights                = ["CreateChild", "DeleteChild"]
  object_type           = "computer"
  inherited_object_type = "organizationalUnit"
  inheritance           = "Descendents"
}

# Write any property on the computer objects themselves.
resource "adds_access_rule" "write_computer_properties" {
  target                = adds_organizational_unit.servers.distinguished_name
  trustee               = adds_group.server_admins.sid
  rights                = ["WriteProperty"]
  object_type           = "All"
  inherited_object_type = "computer"
  inheritance           = "Descendents"
}

# Built-in principals do not need to be managed by Terraform.
resource "adds_access_rule" "authenticated_read" {
  target      = adds_organizational_unit.servers.distinguished_name
  trustee     = "Authenticated Users"
  rights      = ["GenericRead"]
  inheritance = "All"
}

# Deny an extended right.
resource "adds_access_rule" "deny_password_reset" {
  target                = adds_organizational_unit.servers.distinguished_name
  trustee               = "Authenticated Users"
  rights                = ["ExtendedRight"]
  access                = "Deny"
  object_type           = "Reset Password"
  inherited_object_type = "user"
  inheritance           = "Descendents"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `rights` (Set of String) `ActiveDirectoryRights` values combined into a single ACE, for example `["CreateChild", "DeleteChild"]`.
- `target` (String) Object the ACE is applied to. Accepts a slash-delimited path relative to the domain root (for example `Servers` or `Contoso/Servers`), a relative distinguished name such as `CN=Computers`, or a full distinguished name. Slash segments are always OU names. The object does not need to be managed by Terraform.
- `trustee` (String) Principal the ACE grants or denies rights to. Accepts a SID, a distinguished name, `DOMAIN\name`, a `sAMAccountName`, or a well-known name such as `Authenticated Users`.

### Optional

- `access` (String) `Allow` or `Deny`.
- `ignore_admin_count_1` (Boolean) Allow setting this ACE even when `target` has `adminCount = 1` (protected by AdminSDHolder). By default this is an error, because SDProp periodically resets the ACL of any adminCount=1 object to match AdminSDHolder, silently discarding the ACE this resource just added.
- `inheritance` (String) `ActiveDirectorySecurityInheritance`: `None`, `All`, `Descendents`, `SelfAndChildren` or `Children`. Omitting it applies the ACE to the target object only.
- `inherited_object_type` (String) Schema class of the child objects that inherit this ACE, for example `organizationalUnit`. Requires `inheritance`.
- `object_type` (String) Object the rights apply to: a schema class (`computer`), an attribute or property set, an extended right, a GUID, or `All`. Omit for rights that are not object-specific.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier, composed of the target, trustee SID, access type, object type GUIDs and inheritance.
- `inherited_object_type_guid` (String) Resolved GUID of `inherited_object_type`.
- `object_type_guid` (String) Resolved GUID of `object_type`.
- `target_dn` (String) Resolved distinguished name of `target`.
- `trustee_sid` (String) Resolved SID of the trustee.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Access rules are imported with a composite id:
#   <target DN>|<trustee SID>|<access>|<object type GUID>|<inherited object type GUID>|<inheritance>
# Use 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 for an unset GUID and an empty segment for unset inheritance.
terraform import adds_access_rule.create_delete_computers \
  "OU=Servers,OU=Contoso,DC=contoso,DC=local|S-1-5-21-1234567890-1234567890-1234567890-1234|Allow|bf967a86-0de6-11d0-a285-00aa003049e2|bf967aa5-0de6-11d0-a285-00aa003049e2|Descendents"
```
